answer.approach: Build interactive faq as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: aria-expanded, data-, group, focus-visible:, <button.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
